beta.notes:
Native Plex client for MiSTer. Built for CRTs at 480i over Component, RGB, S-Video or Composite, with 480p on HDMI.

Beta access. This is a paid early-access build. Install and browsing work without a code. Playback needs the code from the MisterZine Patreon post. Stable releases will be free and codeless.

New in beta.10
- Cleaner picture in dark scenes. The blocky patches that built up in shadows between keyframes are gone: the video decoder's deblocking filter is back on, paid for by a faster way of fitting each frame to the screen.
- 50 and 60 fps video plays smoothly. The app asks Plex for every other frame (25 or 29.97 fps), which the MiSTer decodes in time, instead of stuttering through the full rate.
- Honest bitrate choices. At 480 lines a Plex server sends at most about 2 Mbps of video however high the cap, so Options > Video bitrate now offers 0.4 Mbps (low res), 1 Mbps, 1.2 Mbps and Max (2 Mbps), each labelled with what the server actually sends. Higher settings saved by older betas read as Max.
- Options > Video geometry. Move each edge of the video in to suit your TV's overscan, and fix a set that draws the picture too wide or too narrow by measuring a square on screen with a ruler. Only the video moves; the menus stay where they are.
- Options > Video crop, and a More button in the playback controls. Off shows the whole picture with black bars. 14:9 trims the sides of widescreen video and leaves thin bars. Fill crops widescreen to fill a 4:3 screen, which also removes the side bars from 4:3 shows stored in widescreen files. Options sets the crop each video starts with; More > Crop changes it for what you're watching.
- No more picture flashing to black with Zaparoo. The Linux console's blinking cursor and a Zaparoo Frontend left running could both draw over the video; Plex now keeps them out of the way while it runs.
- If Zaparoo is installed, Plex now appears under Other in Zaparoo.
- Updates keep only the current and previous release on the SD card instead of every release ever installed.

Requirements
- Networked MiSTer on current MiSTer Linux
- 250 MB free on the SD card
- Plex account with a server that can transcode

Install
1. Download the Beta installer below and put it in the SD card's Scripts folder.
2. Run it from Scripts.
3. Follow the sign-in screen at plex.tv/link.

Already on an earlier beta: open Options > Updates in the app and install from there.

NTSC 480i only; PAL isn't supported yet.

This is unstable beta software. It talks to your real Plex account: playback, watched marks and resume points change your library, and a bug could change them wrongly. Use it at your own risk; no responsibility is taken for what it does to your library or your MiSTer.
